# Takafumi Miyanaga (宮永崇史)

> Software Developer & Researcher specializing in quantum computing systems and cloud architecture

## About

Takafumi Miyanaga (宮永崇史) is a software developer and researcher at Osaka University QIQB, specializing in quantum computing systems and cloud architecture. He is the lead developer of OQTOPUS, an open-source quantum computer operating system powering Japan's first fully domestic quantum computer.

## Key Projects

- OQTOPUS: Open Quantum Toolchain for OPerators & USers - https://oqtopus-team.github.io/
- oqtopus-cloud: Cloud-based quantum computing platform - https://github.com/oqtopus-team/oqtopus-cloud
- mirrormate: Your partner in the mirror - https://github.com/orangekame3/mirrormate
- tftarget: Interactive Terraform target selector - https://github.com/future-architect/tftarget

## Expertise

- Programming Languages: Go (Golang), Python, TypeScript/JavaScript
- Quantum Computing: OpenQASM 3.0, Superconducting Qubits, Cloud Quantum Computing
- Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform, Docker, CI/CD
- Open Source Software Development

## Education & Career

- 2023 - Present: Specially Appointed Researcher, Osaka University QIQB
- 2021 - 2023: Backend Engineer & Consultant, Future Corporation
- 2019 - 2021: M.S. Physics, Tokyo University of Science (Superconducting Quantum Circuits)
- 2015 - 2019: B.S. Physics, Tokyo University of Science

## Publications

- IEEE QCE 2025: "A Practical Open-Source Software Stack for a Cloud-Based Quantum Computing System"
- Physical Review Applied 2021: "Ultrastrong Tunable Coupler Between Superconducting LC Resonators"
- Translation: "Software Mistakes and Tradeoffs" (O'Reilly Japan, 2023)
